claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Etomoxir at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a CPT1A inhibitor in most cancer cell lines, with any killing likely reflecting weak, non-selective cytotoxicity rather than a specific CPT1A-dependent metabolic vulnerability.
